strings.name: George Church
strings.summary: Trained at Duke and Harvard, Church advanced sequencing, open personal genomes and synthetic biology. Human-cell CRISPR editing and multiplex genome engineering involved collaborative teams; he also helped establish biotechnology companies. Species-restoration ambitions raise technical and ethical debates. In 2019 he apologized for meeting Epstein after his conviction, drawing scrutiny of research-funding judgment.
